about: The HSM Powerline FA 400.2 heavy-duty document, digital media, and paper shredder is your top solution for high-volume shredding tasks. Perfect for archives and central shredding stations, this sturdy and durable shredder ensures smooth and efficient operation.

The HSM PET CP 4988 is a highly efficient recycling system designed to reduce the volume of empty PET bottles by up to 90% in a single cycle, producing compact raw material bales. This plastic bottle crusher combines perforation and baling, making it ideal for perforating PET bottles with flatteners and crushers, and subsequently bailing them.
